data.name: Qudsiyah
data.gender_notes: Qudsiyah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Qudsiyah is derived from the Arabic word 'Quds', meaning holy or sacred, often referring to Jerusalem. It signifies a connection to the sacred and divine. The name Qudsiyah carries the meaning “Holy or Sacred” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Qudsiyah usually hope their child will grow to embody holy or sacred and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: The name is reminiscent of the Quranic concept of Al-Quds, emphasizing the spiritual significance of the holy city.
data.etymology: Qudsiyah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Holy or Sacred.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Qudsiyah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.

in_arabic.name: قدسية
in_arabic.long_meaning: اسم قدسية مشتق من الجذر القدسي، ويعني القداسة والطهارة والنزاهة، وهو من الأسماء التي تحمل معاني روحانية عالية، وقد وردت في القرآن الكريم عدة مرات، منها قوله تعالى: "والقدس" في سورة البقرة، الآية 119، وتعني هذه الكلمة المكان المقدس أو الأرض الطاهرة.

in_urdu.name: قدسیہ
in_urdu.meaning: قداست و پاکیزگی اور نزاہت کا مطلب
in_urdu.long_meaning: نام قدسیہ عربی جڑ قدس سے ماخوذ ہے، جس کا مطلب ہے قداست، پاکیزگی اور نزاہت۔ یہ نام اسلامی تقویم میں اہم سمجھا جاتا ہے اور اس کا ذکر قرآن کریم میں بھی آیا ہے، جیسے کہ سورہ بقرہ میں، آية 119، جہاں یہ لفظ 'والقدس' استعمال ہوا ہے۔

in_hindi.name: क़ुद्सियाह
in_hindi.long_meaning: नाम क़ुद्सियाह अरबी मूल का है, जिसका अर्थ है पवित्रता, शुद्धता और निर्मलता। यह नाम हिंदू-मुस्लिम समुदाय में बहुत महत्व रखता है और इसका जिक्र कुरआन में भी मिलता है, विशेष रूप से सूरह अल-बक़राह में, जहां यह 'والقدس' के रूप में प्रयोग किया गया है।

in_pashto.name: قدسيه
in_pashto.long_meaning: د قدسيه نوم د عربي کلمې قدس څخه اخيستل شوی دی، چې د پاکۍ، سپیڅرې او بې ګناهۍ معنی ورکوي. دا نوم د افغانستان په مذهبي کلتور کې مهم دی او په قرآن کريم کې يې د سوره بقره په 119 آيت کې 'والقدس' ډول ذکر دی.

in_english.name: Qudsiyah
in_english.meaning: Derived from 'Quds', meaning holiness, purity, and innocence
in_english.long_meaning: The name Qudsiyah originates from the Arabic root 'Quds', which signifies holiness, purity, and innocence. This name holds significant spiritual connotations and is mentioned in the Quran, specifically in Surah Al-Baqarah, verse 119, as 'والقدس', emphasizing sacredness and cleanliness. In Islamic tradition, Qudsiyah symbolizes a virtuous and righteous personality.

It represents an emotional connection to Jerusalem, which is considered one of the most important religious sites in Islam. The name evokes strong feelings of reverence and respect towards this ancient city and its historical significance.

Thus, the name Qudsiyah serves as a constant reminder of the presence and connection to the divine that permeates the world around us.
